 Nicolás Ramírez, born on November 18, 1986 in González Catán, Argentina, is a football referee who has gained recognition in Argentine football. At 35 years old, he has officiated important matches in the First Division, establishing himself as a prominent figure in national refereeing.Ramírez is known for his balanced approach on the field, combining authority with effective communication towards players. His precise interpretation of the rules and his ability to handle complex situations have earned him the respect of players and coaches.Although his career includes multiple high-profile matches, to date, there is no record of his participation as the main referee in national or international tournament finals.Nicolás Ramírez's career reflects dedication and professionalism in Argentine refereeing, positioning him as a key player in the development of football in the country.
